MY STORY

Mechanical Power Foundation Meets Advanced BIM Execution

I hold a B.Sc. in Mechanical Power Engineering from the Arab Academy for Science and Technology (2023), built upon a strong foundation in mechanical systems design and Building Information Modeling (BIM).

Throughout my career across flagship projects in Saudi Arabia and Egypt, I have focused on delivering clash-free 3D MEP models, verifying real site installations via Scan-to-BIM (Autodesk ReCap), producing construction-ready shop and Builder's Work drawings, and optimizing repetitive modeling tasks through custom pyRevit automation tools.
